race.title: All-Weather Championship Is Back 'Hands And Heels' Apprentice Handicap
race.verdict: Plenty of pace on paper in this competitive 'hands and heels' event. ARANTES NASCIMENTO is narrowly preferred to Stenmark , with Lady Mariko feared if her 7-lb apprentice gets the best out of her. ARANTES NASCIMENTO STENMARK (IRE) LADY MARIKO
race.bettingForecast: Lady Mariko (10/3), Mister Mojito (4/1), Viking Glory (9/2), Handle With Care (8/1), Stenmark (10/1), Guilty Verdict (10/1), This Farh (12/1), Thankuappreciate (16/1), H Key Lails (16/1), Mr Ubiquitous (16/1), Arantes Nascimento (16/1), Mighty Vega (33/1)
